projects.title: WTAKO Network Frontend
projects.description: WTAKO Network's Frontend (this website) is written in Next.js 16 and MobX, with the help of a local LLM in my AI core inside my home. I just hope it looks good enough because I don't have much design sense. This Next.js project is exported as a static site and it is being hosted on my own server. I never liked the idea of Server-Side Rendering (SSR), and I also avoid Vercel as much as possible.
projects.descriptionZH: WTAKO Network 的前端（本網站）是基於 Next.js 16 和 MobX 開發，並藉助我家中 AI 核心中的本地 LLM 協助完成。我只希望它看起來足夠體面，因為我的設計美感有限。這個 Next.js 專案是靜態網站，並託管在我自己的伺服器上。我從不喜歡伺服器端渲染 (SSR) 的概念，也會盡可能避免使用 Vercel。

projects.title: Saren Gaming Monitor
projects.description: Hardware & IoT Monitoring Server with real-time Linux hardware monitoring and IoT device tracking via WebSocket. Collects CPU, memory, temperatures, fan speeds, storage health, and network statistics.
projects.descriptionZH: 硬體與 IoT 監控伺服器，透過 WebSocket 進行即時 Linux 硬體監控和 IoT 裝置追蹤。收集 CPU、記憶體、溫度、風扇轉速、儲存健康狀態和網路統計資料。

projects.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on DGX Spark
projects.description: Recipe for running Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (~176B params, 6B active) on a single NVIDIA DGX Spark with vLLM, using Intel's W4A16 AutoRound int4 checkpoint plus int8 lm_head and fp8 side layers, and an fp8 n-gram PLE table served from local NVMe via mmap, or from another machine's RAM over one-sided RDMA READ. Achieves ~49 tok/s decode with MTP=3 speculative decoding, working prefix caching, and never-evict KV pinning for system prompts. Fork of blazux/qwen3.8-Flash-DGX.
projects.descriptionZH: 在單一 NVIDIA DGX Spark 上用 vLLM 運行 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（約 176B 參數，活躍 6B）的方案，採用 Intel W4A16 AutoRound int4 檢查點，加上 int8 lm_head 與 fp8 邊側層，並以 mmap 從本地 NVMe、或透過單邊 RDMA READ 從另一臺機器的記憶體提供 fp8 n-gram PLE 表。透過 MTP=3 投機解碼達到約 49 tok/s 的生成速度，具備可用的前綴快取，以及系統提示詞的永不淘汰 KV 釘選。為 blazux/qwen3.8-Flash-DGX 的 fork。

projects.title: Home Assistant Cantonese LLM Voice Assistant
projects.description: Cantonese-speaking LLM voice assistant for Home Assistant with natural conversation, tool calling for KMB/HKO APIs, and AI radar analysis. Features ~0.15s STT latency and persistent memory via HA todo. See it in action: https://www.threads.com/@nekomata.saren/post/DXV4Z-AkXp4
projects.descriptionZH: 廣東話驅動的 LLM 語音助手，適用於 Home Assistant，具有自然對話能力、KMB/HKO API 的工具呼叫，以及 AI 雷達分析。具備約 0.15 秒語音識別延遲，並透過 HA 待辦清單實現持久記憶。觀看實際應用：https://www.threads.com/@nekomata.saren/post/DXV4Z-AkXp4

projects.descriptionZH: 優化廣東話的即時語音轉文字系統，具有熱鍵觸發錄音、語音活動檢測（VAD）和自動打字功能。支援 GLM-ASR、SenseVoice、Whisper 和 Qwen ASR 後端。包含 SRT 生成/翻譯工作流程。

art.title: Regal Saren in Traditional Japanese Garb
art.description: Saren depicted as a regal lynx lord with tawny facial fur, a thick white mane, and bright blue eyes, one eye playfully shaded by his raised arm in a confident half-lidded pose. He wears elaborate teal-green and gold robes covered in diamond and geometric patterns, with a wide sleeve draped over his head and a golden horned ornament at the cuff. Ornate details include beaded chains of red and turquoise beads, gold tassels, and a green gem pendant at the chest. A painterly semi-realistic digital style, with warm dramatic light falling from the upper right against a dark, softly blurred interior.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 被描繪為一隻高貴的猞猁領主，面部為紅棕褐色毛髮，擁有濃密的白色鬃毛和明亮的藍色眼睛，一隻手臂高舉過頭、以袖影俏皮地遮住單眼，神情自信而慵懶。他身穿精緻的青綠色與金色長袍，布滿菱形與幾何圖案，寬大的衣袖垂於頭側，袖口飾有金色角狀裝飾。華麗細節包括紅珠與綠松石串成的珠鏈、金色流蘇，以及胸前的綠色寶石吊墜。繪畫感的半寫實數位風格，溫暖的戲劇性光線自右上方灑落，背景為昏暗柔和的模糊室內。

art.title: Grand Fantasy Courtyard
art.description: A painterly fantasy atrium built upward as a towering multi-tiered structure of pale arches, columns and balconies wrapped in climbing vines. Saren, a tan-furred lynx in blue and gold clothing, walks away from the viewer across a flooded reflective floor at the base of the tower. Layers of yellow pennant banners are strung between the levels, and a large circular opening in the roof reveals a blue, light-filtered surface overhead. Cool cyan daylight from above contrasts with warm lantern glow, potted plants and lit candelabra in the foreground.
art.descriptionZH: 一幅繪畫風格的奇幻中庭，以蒼白的拱門、柱子與陽臺向上堆疊成多層高聳結構，四周攀滿藤蔓。Saren 是一隻身穿藍金服飾的棕褐色猞猁，背對觀者走過塔底被水覆蓋、倒映著光線的地面。各層之間懸掛著一層層黃色三角旗，屋頂的圓形大開口透出上方過濾後的藍色光線。來自上方的冷色青藍日光，與前景溫暖的燈籠光暈、盆栽植物和點燃的燭臺形成對比。

art.title: Saren Fursuit Bathroom Pose
art.description: 3D rendered photorealistic Saren fursuit in a modern bathroom with a floor-to-ceiling ocean view. Tan and golden lynx character with bright blue eyes, a white chest ruff, tufted ears, muscular build, and large paws with long pale claws. Shown mid-stride in a low, prowl-like pose leaning toward the viewer on dark wooden flooring, with a hanging shower hose and recessed shelf visible. Soft natural light from the sea-and-sky window.
art.descriptionZH: 現代浴室中的 3D 渲染超寫實 Saren 毛絨服，落地窗外是海景。棕褐色與金色的猞猁角色，亮藍色眼睛、白色胸鬃、耳尖有簇毛，肌肉健壯，大型雙爪帶有長而淡色的爪子。以低伏潛行的姿態邁步朝鏡頭逼近，站在深色木地板上，旁側可見垂掛的淋浴軟管與嵌入牆內的置物格。來自海景窗戶的柔和自然光照明。

art.title: Tribal Warrior Saren Flexing
art.description: Cheerful Saren flexing one bicep in a confident three-quarter pose, with orange-tan fur, dark facial markings and limb stripes, a fluffy white mane, and bright blue eyes. He wears a tribal-style halter top with blue and orange geometric patterns, a fringed hem, and braided beaded tassels, along with woven wrist wraps, a fur-trimmed belt with sashes, and a light blue cape flowing behind. Rendered in a sketchy comic style with bold line art and flat coloring on a plain neutral background.
art.descriptionZH: 開朗的 Saren 以充滿自信的三四側身姿展示肱二頭肌，橙色棕褐色毛髮，臉部有深色斑紋、四肢帶條紋，蓬鬆的白色鬃毛，亮藍色眼睛。身穿藍橙幾何圖案的部落風格掛脖上衣，下擺帶流蘇，飾有編織珠飾流蘇繩，搭配編織手腕護帶、毛皮滾邊腰帶與垂帶，淺藍色斗篷在身後飄動。以帶粗獷線稿和平塗上色的漫畫素描風格繪製，背景為簡潔的中性色。

art.title: Saren Tribal Warrior Capture Scene
art.description: Anime-style illustration set in a lush green forest, with Saren as a tribal hunter: a tan-furred lynx with a white mane, spotted markings, and blue eyes, roaring with bared fangs. He holds a long spear in one paw while the other grips the dark hair of a human warrior tied to a tree trunk. The human, dressed in primitive brown hides with a teal pendant, clutches the rope binding his chest, face flushed and crying out in distress. Saren wears a colorful feather collar and belt with a large blue gem buckle, plus brown leather arm wraps.
art.descriptionZH: 動漫風格插畫，背景為鬱鬱蔥蔥的森林，Saren 以部落獵人形象登場：棕褐色毛髮的猞猁，白色鬃毛與斑點紋理，藍色眼睛，張口咆哮露出尖牙。他一手持長矛，另一手抓住被繩索綁在樹幹上的黑髮人類戰士的頭髮。人類身穿原始棕色獸皮服飾，佩戴青綠色墜飾，抓著綁在胸前的繩索，臉頰泛紅，痛苦地呼喊。Saren 佩戴彩色羽毛領飾與腰帶，腰帶扣鑲有藍色大寶石，雙臂纏著棕色皮革護腕。

art.title: Saren Japanese Village Night
art.description: Saren, a tan lynx with a white mane, dark facial markings and bright blue eyes, sits on a wooden deck at low angle in a traditional Japanese village at night. He wears a striped orange-and-cream geometric poncho, a turquoise-beaded necklace with tassels, and patterned leg wraps, with his tail curled at his side. His expression is calm and composed rather than cheerful. Warm lantern light from the wooden buildings contrasts with the deep blue starlit sky in a clean comic-book style with bold linework.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 是一隻棕褐色猞猁，白色鬃毛、臉部有深色斑紋、雙眼湛藍，以低視角構圖坐在夜晚傳統日式村莊的木質陽臺上。他身穿橙米相間的條紋幾何圖案披風，佩戴綠松石珠飾流蘇項鍊，雙腿纏有圖紋裹布，尾巴捲於身側。神情沉穩內斂，而非開懷笑容。木屋的溫暖燈光與深藍星空形成對比，畫風為乾淨的美式漫畫風格，線條粗獷鮮明。

art.title: Fantasy Market City Scene
art.description: Wide anime-style panorama of a bustling medieval fantasy market street in an ornate European-style city. At center stands Saren, a white-furred lynx with blue eyes in ornate crimson plate armor, beside a dark-haired young man holding up a glowing green magic disc. Market stalls at left hang with brass lanterns and mounds of colorful spices, while a Gothic clock tower rises in the background, warm sunlight streaming through a distant archway and glittering particles drifting through the air.
art.descriptionZH: 動漫風格的寬幅全景畫，描繪繁華的中世紀奇幻市場街道，置身裝飾華麗的歐式城市。畫面中央是白毛藍眼的猞猁 Saren，身穿華麗的深紅色鎧甲，身旁一位黑髮青年高舉發著綠光的魔法圓盤。左側攤位懸掛黃銅燈籠，堆放著各色香料；背景矗立哥特式鐘樓，溫暖陽光透過遠處拱門灑入，空中飄浮著閃爍光粒。

art.title: Fantasy Grand Ballroom Scene
art.description: Wide panoramic fantasy scene with the anthropomorphic lynx character Saren seen from behind, wearing a dark formal coat with his fluffy tawny tail visible, standing at the center of a vast multi-level atrium. Arcaded balconies and terraces on all sides are crowded with formally dressed guests, draped with flowering vines and lit by warm amber lanterns and candlelight. Above the open-air venue, disc-shaped platforms float in a dreamy teal sky, contrasting the warm glow below with a cool ethereal light. The composition evokes a grand magical gala viewed from the arrival courtyard.
art.descriptionZH: 寬幅全景奇幻場景：猞猁角色 Saren 身穿深色正式禮服，背對觀者站在宏偉的多層中庭中央，身後露出蓬鬆的黃褐色尾巴。四周拱廊式陽臺與露臺擠滿盛裝賓客，垂掛著開花的藤蔓，由溫暖的琥珀色燈籠與燭光照明。露天場地上方，碟狀平臺漂浮在夢幻的青藍色天空中，與下方的暖光形成清冷空靈的對比。整體構圖宛如從迎賓庭院遠眺一場盛大的魔法宴會。

art.title: Fantasy Ballroom Vertical View
art.description: Vertical fantasy illustration of an epic multi-level ballroom. In the left foreground, Saren, an anthropomorphic lynx with light blond fur and a long spotted tail, stands with his back to the viewer in a dark formal coat, looking out over the scene. Arced balconies and terraces packed with formally dressed guests rise on both sides, draped with hanging vines and flowers, while ornate chandeliers and floral baskets float overhead against a misty teal sky. Warm golden lamplight from below contrasts with the cool blue haze above, with birds circling in the distance; a dreamy, atmospheric digital-painting style.
art.descriptionZH: 史詩奇幻舞廳的垂直構圖數位繪圖。畫面左側前景，人形猞猁 Saren 背對觀者而立，淺金色毛髮、長而帶斑點的尾巴清晰可見，身穿深色正式長禮服，眺望遠方。兩側拱形陽臺與平臺層層升高，擠滿盛裝的賓客，垂掛著藤蔓與花卉；華麗的吊燈與花籃懸浮於青綠色霧蒙的天空之下。下方溫暖的金色燈光與上方清冷的藍色霧氣形成對比，遠處有鳥兒盤旋，整體氛圍如夢似幻。

art.title: Saren in Fantastical City
art.description: Painterly fantasy illustration of a tall, shirtless Saren — a muscular lynx character with tan spotted fur, a white mane, tufted ears, and blue eyes, wearing a beaded necklace and a green sash over a pale fur wrap — striding through a bustling crowd. Behind him rises a towering, densely packed fantasy city rendered in warm golds, oranges, and teals, with archways and balconies climbing toward a sky of pink smoke, a pale crescent moon, and stars. Golden dragon-like creatures soar overhead, while a smaller dark-haired human in a cloak stands in the foreground watching the scene.
art.descriptionZH: 一幅富有繪畫感的奇幻插畫，高大的赤裸 Saren——肌肉健壯的猞猁角色，棕褐色帶斑點的毛髮、白色鬃毛、耳尖有簇毛、藍色眼睛，頸戴串珠項鍊，腰間繫綠色腰帶並圍著淺色毛皮——大步穿行於熱鬧的人群中。他身後聳立著密集堆疊的奇幻城市，以溫暖的金黃色、橙色和青色描繪，拱門與陽臺層層攀升，通向繚繞粉色煙雲、蒼白月牙與繁星的天空。金色的龍狀飛行生物在高空盤旋，前景中一名身披斗篷的黑髮人類角色佇立眺望著這片景象。

art.title: Saren and Kokumo Cyberpunk City
art.description: Wide panoramic digital illustration of Saren (tan lynx with a white mane ruff, blue eyes, and a patterned brown-gold tunic with shoulder mantle) and Kokumo (dark-furred dragon with a white neck ruff, red eyes, and black armor with a red-trimmed cape) walking hand in hand toward the viewer down a crowded Asian-style fantasy city street. Chinese neon signs, shopfront banners and red lanterns fill the multi-level streetscape, with confetti in the air and a large floating city hanging in the bright daytime sky. Anime-influenced semi-realistic painting style with warm tones and cinematic composition.
art.descriptionZH: 寬幅全景數位插畫，Saren（棕褐色猞猁，白色鬃毛，藍眼睛，身穿圖案棕金色長袍並披肩飾）與 Kokumo（深色毛龍，白色頸毛，紅色眼睛，黑色鎧甲搭配紅邊披風）手牽手沿著熱鬧的亞洲風格奇幻街道朝觀者走來。多層街道佈滿中文霓虹燈牌、商店橫幅與紅燈籠，空中飄散彩色紙屑，明亮的白日高懸一座漂浮城市。動漫風格的半寫實繪製，色調溫暖，具電影感構圖。

art.title: Monster Hunter x How to Train Your Dragon Crossover
art.description: A Monster Hunter x How to Train Your Dragon crossover fan artwork in a cozy tavern, rendered in a polished painterly semi-realistic digital style. Toothless the Night Fury rests his front paws on a wooden table, watching a chef-hatted Palico stir a pot over a small firepot, while a sword hilt lies across the table in the foreground. A young armored man resembling Hiccup reads a map as an elderly pointy-eared wyverian points at it, and a horned female warrior in white fur-trimmed armor approaches from the right. Warm golden sunlight streams through diamond-paned windows over the tavern's wooden interior and background patrons.
art.descriptionZH: 《魔物獵人》x《馴龍高手》跨界同人創作，描繪溫馨的酒館場景，採用精緻的寫實質感手繪數位風格。無牙（Night Fury）將前爪擱在木桌上，盯著一隻戴廚師帽的侍貓（Palico）在小火盆上的鍋裡攪拌烹調，前景桌角橫放著一柄大劍的劍柄。一名形似 Hiccup 的年輕鎧甲男子閱讀地圖，旁邊年長的龍人族男性伸手指點；右側一名頭生獨角、身著白色鑲毛邊鎧甲的女戰士走來。溫暖的金色陽光透過菱形格窗戶灑入木質酒館，背景可見其他客人。

art.title: Saren Winter Portrait
art.description: Half-body portrait of Saren, a spotted lynx-like character with tan-and-white fur, large tufted ears, and bright blue eyes, wearing a faint confident smile. He wears a light blue-gray beret with a dark band and a small feather ornament, a matching oversized scarf draped over a bare chest, and a bone/teeth necklace. Rendered in a minimalist style with clean lineart and flat coloring, his spotted tail curling up behind him against a plain white background.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 的半身肖像，棕褐色與白色相間的斑點毛髮，長有毛束的大耳朵，湛藍雙眼，帶著一絲自信的微笑。頭戴淺藍灰色貝雷帽，配深色束帶與小巧羽毛裝飾，同色系寬大圍巾垂掛在裸露的胸前，頸上戴著骨頭/牙齒項鍊。乾淨線稿搭配平塗色塊的極簡風格，身後斑點尾巴向上翹起，背景純白簡潔。

art.title: Dynamic Saren Action Pose
art.description: Muscular Saren in a dynamic leaping action pose, mouth open in a snarl and head turned to the side, with flowing white mane, tufted ears, spotted tan fur and extended claws. Wearing tribal accessories including a colorful geometric beaded collar with fang pendants, beaded wristbands and anklets, a blue crystal on one wrist, and a blue patterned fabric wrap at the hip with dangling ribbons and tassels. A fluffy tail tipped with a turquoise crescent ornament trails behind. Bold anime-style lineart and cel shading over a vibrant streaked background of reds, oranges, blues and greens suggesting speed and energy.
art.descriptionZH: 肌肉結實的 Saren 呈現動態躍起的動作姿態，開口咆哮並側頭回望，白色鬃毛飄逸，耳朵帶有簇毛，棕褐色斑點毛髮，爪子伸展。佩戴部落配飾，包括幾何圖案的彩色串珠領飾並懸掛尖牙吊墜、串珠手環與腳環、單側手腕的藍色水晶，以及腰間藍色圖案布質腰封，垂墜絲帶與流蘇。蓬鬆尾巴末端帶有綠松石色新月飾物。大膽的動漫式線稿與賽璐璐上色，搭配紅、橙、藍、綠的鮮豔條紋背景，暗示速度與能量。

art.title: Saren Rooftop Night Watch
art.description: Saren, a tan-furred lynx with a white mane, tufted ears and blue eyes, sits relaxed on a wooden crate on a weathered rooftop, a drink can in hand, with a small table of teaware beside him. He wears a dark military-style uniform with gold trim. Below, a dense old-European town of gabled houses glows with warm window light against the cool blue-grey dusk sky, seen from a high overhead angle. A lantern-strung utility pole and a faint meteor streak complete the quiet, melancholic night atmosphere.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 是一隻棕褐色毛髮、白色鬃毛、耳尖帶簇毛、藍眼睛的猞猁，悠閒地坐在斑駁屋頂的木箱上，手持一罐飲料，身旁的小桌擺著茶具。他身穿鑲金邊的深色軍裝風制服。下方密集的老歐洲式山牆房屋透出溫暖窗光，與冷調藍灰的黃昏天空形成對比，畫面採高處俯瞰視角。懸掛燈籠的電線桿與一道微弱流星，烘托出靜謐而略帶憂鬱的夜色氛圍。

art.title: Saren Scarf Portrait
art.description: Half-body portrait of Saren, a lynx-eared anthro with orange-tan spotted fur, a shaggy white mane and beard, and piercing light-blue eyes in a stern expression. He wears a heavy dark olive poncho-style scarf patterned with geometric zigzags and finished with tassels. Sunlit domed architecture glows in the upper-left background against an otherwise shadowed, teal-toned scene in this semi-realistic digital painting.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 半身肖像，猞猁耳的獸人形象，橙棕色斑點毛髮，蓬亂的白色鬃毛與鬍鬚，淺藍色雙眼神情嚴肅。身披深橄欖色斗篷式圍巾，飾有鋸齒幾何圖案與流蘇。半寫實數位繪畫，陽光下的圓頂建築映於左上方背景，其餘場景沉浸在偏青綠的陰影之中。

art.title: Grand Fantasy Atrium
art.description: A towering multi-level fantasy atrium of ornate baroque facades, balconies and staircases rising into a misty teal sky, with flowers spilling over terraces and floating structures suspended overhead. In the left foreground Saren is seen from behind in a brown cloak, his spotted lynx face turned over his shoulder, a long pale bushy tail visible. Groups of casually dressed people mingle in the sunlit plaza around and below him, warm golden light glowing from the lower right against the cool blue-green tones above. A digital painting in a cinematic concept-art matte-painting style.
art.descriptionZH: 高聳的多層奇幻中庭，精美的巴洛克式立面、陽臺與階梯層層疊起，延伸至迷濛的青綠色天空，露臺上花卉傾瀉而下，空中懸浮著浮動的平臺。左側前景中 Saren 身披棕色斗篷背對觀者，斑紋猞猁臉龐自肩頭回望，可見一條長而蓬鬆的淺色尾巴。數群穿著休閒的人們在他周圍及下方陽光充足的廣場上交談，右下角溫暖的金色光暈與上方的冷調青綠色形成對比。一幅具有電影感概念藝術風格的數位繪畫。

art.title: Saren Armored Warrior
art.description: Saren as a powerful warrior, an anthropomorphic lynx with a shaggy white mane, tufted ears, spotted tan face markings and piercing blue eyes. He wears ornate bronze and gold armor inlayed with blue gems and engraved scrollwork, with a necklace and clawed metal gauntlets, one hand thrust toward the viewer. Painted in a semi-realistic digital fantasy style, framed from a low angle against a dark stormy background crossed by diagonal streaks of glowing blue energy.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 作為強健的戰士形象，是一名獸人化的猞猁：蓬鬆的白色鬃毛、耳尖長毛、棕褐色面部斑紋，雙眼湛藍銳利。身著華麗的青銅與金色鎧甲，鑲嵌藍色寶石並飾以雕刻紋樣，頸戴項鏈，雙手佩戴鋒利的金屬利爪護手，一隻手直逼觀者。採用半寫實數位奇幻繪風，以低角度構圖，神祕黑暗風暴背景中劃過發光的藍色能量條紋。

art.title: Saren Formal Suit Portrait
art.description: Photorealistic AI-generated studio portrait of Saren as an anthropomorphic lynx, standing in a relaxed three-quarter pose with both furred paws tucked into his pockets. He wears an open off-white blazer with rolled sleeves and matching trousers over a dark navy button-up shirt. The tawny lynx head has bright blue eyes, a long flowing cream mane, and black-tipped ear tufts, while a fluffy tawny tail with a black-and-white tip extends at his side. Soft, even lighting against a neutral gray backdrop gives the image a clean fashion-catalogue look.
art.descriptionZH: 超寫實 AI 生成的攝影棚人像，Saren 以擬人化猞猁形象出現，以放鬆的微側身姿態站立，毛茸茸的雙爪插在褲袋中。他身穿敞開的米白色西裝外套，袖口捲起，搭配同色長褲，內穿深海軍藍鈕扣襯衫。棕黃色猞猁頭部有著亮藍色眼睛、長而飄逸的奶油色鬃毛和帶黑色尖端的耳簇，身側伸出毛茸鬆的棕黃色尾巴，尾端黑白相間。柔和均勻的照明搭配中性灰色背景，營造出簡潔的時尚型錄風格。

art.title: Saren Overlooking Night Village
art.description: Saren's fursuit seen in profile at a rope-bound wooden railing on a dark cliff-edge platform, overlooking a hillside village glowing with warm golden lights at night. Taken from a low angle, the light-maned lynx in dark clothing stands out against a deep night sky while tiered rooftops, an illuminated arch bridge, and blue- and green-lit trees fill the valley below. A quiet, contemplative travel photo. Fursuit by Inerri Creatures. Clothing enhanced by AI.
art.descriptionZH: 以低角度取景，Saren 的毛絨服以側面輪廓出現在黑暗崖邊平臺的繩索木護欄旁，俯瞰夜晚點綴著溫暖金黃燈光的山坡村莊。身著深色衣物的淺色鬃毛猞猁與深沉夜空形成對比，下方山谷中層層屋頂、一座亮燈的拱橋以及藍綠色照明的樹木盡收眼底。一張安靜、令人沉思的旅行照片。毛絨服由 Inerri Creatures 製作，服裝經 AI 增強。

art.title: Saren Scarf Sketch Style
art.description: Loose sketch-style drawing of Saren with a white spiky mane, tan lynx face, and narrowed bright blue eyes, small fang showing in a slight snarl. Bare muscular chest and spotted tan arms and torso, with a large fringed brown scarf draped cloak-like over the shoulders and gripped by one raised paw at the shoulder. Wears simple beige pants, with a tan-and-white tail visible behind, all rendered in energetic line work with flat color on a minimal gray-and-white background.
art.descriptionZH: 筆觸鬆散的素描風格繪畫，Saren 有著白色尖刺鬃毛、棕褐色猞猁臉龐和微眯的亮藍色眼睛，微露齒牙帶一絲兇狠。裸露的肌肉胸膛與帶斑點的棕褐色雙臂和軀幹，一條帶流蘇的棕色大圍巾如斗篷般披在肩上，被舉起的一隻爪子在肩頭抓住。下身著簡樸的米色長褲，身後可見棕白相間的尾巴，以充滿活力的線稿搭配平塗色彩繪於簡潔的灰白背景上。

art.title: Saren Desert Wanderer
art.description: Saren the lynx shown from behind in a three-quarter view, glancing back over one shoulder with bright teal eyes and a slight fanged smirk. Cream-and-peach fur with dark pointed ear tufts and facial markings, draped cape-like in a serape of teal, maroon and grey-green geometric bands that trail off to one side. The background is a minimalist pink desert hillscape under a pale sky, rendered in a flat, hard-edged digital painting style. The warm palette and soft rim lighting give the piece a quiet desert-wanderer mood at sunrise or sunset.
art.descriptionZH: 猞猁角色 Saren 以四分之三背向構圖呈現，越肩回眸，青藍色雙眼明亮，微張的嘴露出一絲帶犬齒的笑意。奶油色與桃色毛髮，深色尖聳的耳簇與面部斑紋，身上如披風般裹著青綠、酒紅與灰綠色幾何條紋氈毯，毯角向一側飄逸延伸。背景是蒼白天空下極簡的粉紅色沙漠丘陵，以扁平、硬邊筆觸的數位繪畫風格繪製。溫暖的色調與柔和的邊緣光為作品營造出日出或日落時分平靜的沙漠流浪者氛圍。

art.title: Saren Overlooking Eastern Village at Night
art.description: Saren, the lynx fursona, viewed from behind in a heavy dark cloak, white ruff and long bushy tail visible, standing on high ground framed by overhanging branches. Below spreads a lantern-lit traditional East Asian town of pagoda-style rooftops, while a hazy skyline of modern skyscrapers rises on the horizon — an old-meets-future cityscape under a teal night sky. A bright full moon and a second pale blue orb hang above the mist, and warm orange city glow contrasts the cool tones for a peaceful, contemplative mood.
art.descriptionZH: 從後方看到的 Saren，猞猁角色身披厚重的深色斗篷，露出白色頸毛與長長蓬鬆的尾巴，站在被樹枝環繞的高地上。下方是傳統東亞城鎮，塔式屋頂點綴著溫暖燈籠；遠方地平線卻矗立著薄霧中的現代摩天大樓天際線——新舊交融的城市夜景懸於青藍色夜空之下。一輪明亮的滿月與另一顆淡藍色星球高掛霧氣之上，溫暖的橙色城市光暈與冷色調形成對比，營造平和、沉思的氛圍。

art.title: Saren Photorealistic Portrait
art.description: Photorealistic portrait of Saren as a powerful anthropomorphic lynx with striking blue eyes and light tan fur. Shown from the thighs up in a three-quarter stance, bare-chested with a muscular build, long flowing mane and chest fur, and characteristic black-tipped ear tufts. A calm, direct gaze under neutral studio lighting against a dark gray backdrop emphasizes the realistic rendering style.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 的超寫實肖像，作為強健的擬人化猞猁，擁有引人注目的藍眼睛和淺棕褐色毛髮。以四分之三側身站姿呈現，畫面由大腿以上取景，赤裸上身展現肌肉體格，長而飄逸的鬃毛與胸毛，以及標誌性的黑色耳簇。沉著直視的目光搭配中性攝影棚照明，襯於深灰色背景前，強調寫實渲染風格。

art.title: Saren Throne King Portrait
art.description: Full-body royal portrait of Saren, a light tan lynx with a cream mane, tufted ears and striking blue eyes, seated regally on an ornate wooden throne with gilded scrollwork and a red upholstered back. He grins with a flash of fangs, one arm draped over the armrest in a relaxed but commanding pose, wearing a red vest with a yellow X on the chest, green pants with yellow knee patches and frayed hems, and white bandages wrapped around his arms and lower legs. Dark red and green velvet curtains with a sliver of night sky frame the scene, rendered in a photorealistic 3D style.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 的全身王者肖像：淺棕褐色猞猁，奶油色鬃毛與耳尖簇毛，雙眼湛藍醒目，莊嚴地坐在雕工華麗、飾有金色捲紋與紅色軟墊靠背的木製寶座上。他咧嘴露齒而笑，單臂閒適卻威嚴地搭在扶手上；身穿胸前帶黃色 X 圖案的紅色背心、帶黃色膝蓋補丁與磨破褲腳的綠色長褲，雙臂與小腿纏著白色繃帶。背景以深紅與墨綠色絨布簾幕框出場景，上方露出一線夜空，整體呈現寫實 3D 渲染風格。

art.title: Dynamic Crouching Pose
art.description: Saren, a lynx character with a white mane, tawny face, blue eyes, and large dark tufted ears, crouches low in a forward-leaning stance with one paw resting on his knee. He wears a red visor cap, a red sleeveless vest marked with a yellow X, torn green pants with yellow knee patches, and white bandages wrapped around his forearms and shins, with bare clawed feet. A long bushy brown tail arcs upright behind him. The fully rendered figure is lit by a warm spotlight against a dark grey backdrop of unfinished pencil-sketch line art of an interior scene.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 以白色鬃毛、棕褐色臉龐、藍色雙眼與深棕色大耳簇，呈現前傾低蹲的姿勢，一隻爪子擱在膝上。他頭戴紅色遮陽帽，身穿飾有黃色 X 圖案的紅色無袖背心，綠色破邊長褲配有黃色膝蓋補丁，前臂與小腿纏繞白色繃帶，雙腳赤裸露出爪子。一條棕褐色長毛尾巴在身後向上拱起。完整繪製的角色由暖色聚光燈照亮，深灰色背景為未完成的室內場景鉛筆素描線稿。

art.title: Dream Scene
art.description: A serene tiled terrace at sunset, rendered in a sketchy anime background-art style with visible line work. The sun sits low on the horizon in a warm orange-to-yellow gradient sky, seen beneath the curved canopy of a large parasol spanning the top of the frame. On the left, a pale stone wall with an arched doorway glows with warm lens flare, while a wooden railing casts long shadows across the tiles and a planted bed with overhanging green foliage fills the right side.
art.descriptionZH: 日落時分寧靜的瓷磚露臺，以帶有明顯線稿的動漫背景繪畫風格繪製。太陽低掛在地平線上，天空呈現溫暖的橙黃漸層，畫面上方可見一把大型遮陽傘的弧形傘簷。左側淺色石牆開有拱形門口，映著溫暖的鏡頭光暈；木製護欄在瓷磚地面投下長長影子，右側是栽種綠色植物的花圃，枝葉自右上角垂入畫面。

art.title: Oil Portrait
art.description: Hand-painted oil portrait of Saren the lynx on a small canvas, shown in a straight-on bust composition with golden-cream fur, large black-tipped tufted ears, and bright blue eyes against a deep blue starry night sky with a faint moon. Cool blue shading on the fur suggests moonlight, giving the warm-faced character a calm, gentle expression. He wears green garments with gold crisscross shoulder straps and layered gold necklaces draped across his chest fur. Photographed as a physical canvas laid on purple fabric.
art.descriptionZH: 在小型畫布上手繪的 Saren 猞猁油畫肖像，採正面半身構圖，金奶油色毛髮，帶黑色尖端的簇毛大耳，亮藍色眼睛，背景是懸著淡淡明月的深藍色星空。毛髮上的冷藍色陰影呈現月光效果，讓暖色臉龐的角色顯得平靜溫和。身穿綠色服裝，肩部有金色交叉飾帶，胸前毛髮垂掛多層金色項鍊。照片為實體畫布平放在紫色布面上拍攝。

art.title: Kokumo Fursona Reference
art.description: Clean flat-cel-shaded character reference sheet for Kokumo (刻雲), a white-and-black bipedal furred dragon with a fluffy spiky mane, large bushy tail, and red eyes, drawn by Raptor21 in 2023. Labeled with Chinese trait notes, it shows three full-body views — front, side, and a casual-outfit variant in a black vest with red tie — plus four head expressions, a diamond color legend for eye, mane, paw-pad and body colors, and a silhouette body-type comparison. A small inset at the bottom shows Saren as a tan lynx cuddling a small cat-form Kokumo, matching the notes describing him as a black-cat angel able to shift into cat form.
art.descriptionZH: 由 Raptor21 於 2023 年繪製的 Kokumo（刻雲）角色參考圖，採用乾淨的平塗賽璐璐風格：白黑相間的雙足毛龍，頭部有尖刺狀蓬鬆鬃毛，大尾巴，紅色眼睛。圖中以中文標註各項設定，包含三個全身視圖——正面、側面，以及穿黑色背心搭配紅領帶的休閒造型——另有四種頭部表情、以菱形圖例標示的眼瞳／鬃毛／肉墊／體色配色，以及剪影體型對比。底部小插圖是棕色猞猁 Saren 抱著貓形態的迷你 Kokumo，呼應設定中他能變身成貓的「黑貓小天使」描述。

art.title: Saren & Kokumo Stickers
art.description: A sheet of 24 LINE/Telegram-style chat stickers of Saren and Kokumo's everyday life and funny faces. Saren, a tan lynx with a white mane, blue eyes and green-and-gold clothing, appears alongside Kokumo, a black-furred dragon with a white spiky mane, red eyes and a red scarf. The flat chibi-style tiles show a wide range of expressions and gags — waving, shock, confusion, tearful joy, sleeping, flexing, a paw-pad close-up, and small shared scenes of the two together — drawn with clean lines and a soft palette on plain backgrounds. | Telegram (Free): https://t.me/addstickers/saren_kokumo_vol1 | LINE ($0.99 each pack, all revenue goes to the artist): https://store.line.me/stickershop/product/31326198/ https://store.line.me/stickershop/product/32209566/
art.descriptionZH: Saren 和 Kokumo 的 LINE/Telegram 聊天貼圖合集，共 24 張，展現兩人的日常生活和顏藝。棕褐色猞猁 Saren（白色鬃毛、藍眼睛、身穿綠金服飾）與黑毛白刺鬃、紅眼繫紅巾的毛龍 Kokumo 一同登場。flat Q版風格的貼圖涵蓋豐富的表情與梗——打招呼、震驚、疑惑、喜極而泣、睡覺、秀肌肉、肉推特寫，以及兩人互動的小場景——線條簡潔、配色柔和，背景素淨。 | Telegram (免費): https://t.me/addstickers/saren_kokumo_vol1 | LINE (每包 $0.99，收益全歸畫師): https://store.line.me/stickershop/product/31326198/ https://store.line.me/stickershop/product/32209566/

art.title: PalWorld Scene
art.description: Saren, a spotted tan-furred character with a cream mane and long ears, laughs with eyes shut while burying his hands in the fluffy chest of Chillet, a giant light-blue Palworld character who grins and blushes behind him. Saren wears a green tank top with gold trim, gold bracelets, and a teal waist wrap, and small pixel-style pink hearts float between them. Flat cel-shaded cartoon style in a tall vertical composition on a soft mint-green background; signed and dated 2024-2-3.
art.descriptionZH: 斑點黃褐色毛髮、奶油色鬃毛與長耳的 Saren 閉著眼睛大笑，雙手埋進巨大淺藍色幻獸帕魯疾旋鼬蓬鬆的胸毛裡，疾旋鼬在身後露齒微笑、臉頰泛紅。Saren 穿著金邊綠色背心，戴金色手鐲，腰間繫著青綠色腰巾，兩人之間飄著粉紅色像素風愛心。平面賽璐珞上色風格，豎長構圖，柔和薄荷綠背景；有簽名並標註日期 2024-2-3。

art.title: Store Scene
art.description: Two anthropomorphic characters chatting in a warehouse-style store aisle. Saren (a tall spotted lynx with blue eyes, green tank top) grins down while holding a shopping bag, facing Folf (a smaller wolf with a grey face, red eye markings, a single blue horn, black shirt and a blue crystal pendant necklace), who gestures up at him. Aisle signage reading Y2-Y26 hangs overhead, with a shopper visible down the aisle. Anime-style cartoon art in warm tones. Character owner of Folf: https://x.com/fenrirschwart
art.descriptionZH: 兩位擬人化角色在倉儲式賣場的通道上聊天。Saren（高個子的斑點猞猁，藍色眼睛，穿綠色背心）手提購物袋，咧嘴俯視著Folf（個子較小的狼，灰色臉孔、眼部有紅色紋記、頭上長著一隻藍色角，穿黑色上衣並戴著藍色水晶吊墜項鍊），Folf則抬手比劃著與他交談。頭上方懸掛著寫有Y2-Y26的通道指示牌，遠處通道上還可見另一位顧客。動漫風格卡通繪畫，色調溫暖。Folf角色的歸屬者：https://x.com/fenrirschwart

art.title: Cactus Desert Wanderer
art.description: Saren, an anthropomorphic lynx with tawny fur and tousled white hair, strides through a swirling sandstorm and glances back over his shoulder with a hard, steady gaze. He wears a dark sleeveless top trimmed with a tuft of white fur at the chest, an ornate patterned sash with tassels, and a fringed blue cape whipping out behind him in the wind. A curved sword hangs low in his right hand, its tip near a sweeping trail of blown sand. The piece is a painterly digital illustration in muted tan and ochre tones, with the storm softening the lower body into haze.
art.descriptionZH: 猞猁角色 Saren，毛色赭黃、白髮凌亂，在席捲的沙塵暴中前行，回首以堅定的目光直視前方。他身穿深色無袖上衣，胸前綴有一撮白色毛皮，腰繫帶流蘇的華麗織紋腰帶，藍色流蘇斗篷在風中向身後翻捲。右手反握彎刀低垂，刀尖臨近被風捲起的沙痕。此作為繪畫風格的數位插畫，以柔和的沙褐色與土黃色調為主，風沙使下半身漸隱於迷濛之中。

art.title: Shirtless Warrior Pose
art.description: Commissioned from artist eggtart, Saren stands shirtless in a confident warrior stance, one paw gripping the hilt of a large dark sword resting across his shoulders. The spotted lynx has a white mane, blue eyes, a muscular torso, teal cropped pants with a strapped black belt, dark fingerless gauntlets, white leg wraps, and a long spotted tail. Clean comic-style lineart with flat coloring and a grainy texture, set against a warm sepia backdrop of faint ruins accented with white paint-splatter bursts.
art.descriptionZH: 委託畫師 eggtart 創作的作品：Saren 赤裸上身，以自信的戰士姿態站立，一隻爪子握住橫擱肩後的大型深色長劍劍柄。斑點猞猁，白色鬃毛和藍色眼睛，軀幹肌肉結實，穿著青色束口長褲、帶束帶的黑色腰帶、深色露指護手和白色腿部裹布，身後垂著帶斑點的長尾巴。乾淨的漫畫風線稿搭配平塗色彩與顆粒質感，溫暖的褐色背景隱約可見廢墟輪廓，點綴著白色潑墨般的飛濺效果。

art.title: Sleeping Under Tree
art.description: Commission by TOOMIRO showing Saren napping peacefully under a tree, lying on his side on a cushion in warm dappled sunlight. The tan-furred lynx has a white mane, closed eyes and a soft smile, one paw resting on his belly and his spotted tail curled upward behind him. He wears a green outfit with gold-trimmed crisscross edging, a gold collar, and teal striped trousers, with a green gold-patterned cloth beside him. A soft painterly style with golden light flares, and a handwritten 'For Saren' dedication signed in the lower right.
art.descriptionZH: TOOMIRO 的委託作品，描繪 Saren 在樹下斑駁的溫暖陽光中側躺於坐墊上安眠。這隻棕褐色毛髮的猞猁有著白色鬃毛，雙眼閉合、面帶淺笑，一隻爪子搭在腹部，身後點狀斑紋的尾巴向上捲起。他身穿金色菱形滾邊的綠色服裝，佩戴金色項飾，下身為藍綠色條紋長褲，身旁鋪著帶金色圖紋的綠色布料。柔和的繪畫風格搭配金色光暈，右下角可見手寫「For Saren」簽名題字。

art.title: Playful Necklace Pose
art.description: A commission from artist novox: Saren winks playfully while holding up a golden pendant necklace with both paws at his chest. The spotted tan lynx has a cream mane, black-tipped ear tufts, and a bright blue eye, dressed in a cropped green jacket with yellow criss-cross trim over a dark green top, gold bangles on one wrist and a green cuff on the other arm. Two pink hearts float beside his cheeks against a mint-green striped backdrop, with 'To Saren' lettered in orange cursive and the artist's signature.
art.descriptionZH: 來自畫師 novox 的約稿作品：Saren 俏皮地眨著一隻眼，雙爪在胸前舉起一條金色吊墜項鍊。這隻棕褐色斑點猞猁有著奶油色鬃毛、黑色耳尖簇毛和明亮的藍色眼睛，身穿鑲黃色交叉紋飾的綠色短夾克，內搭深綠色上衣，一隻手腕戴著金色手鐲，另一隻手臂套著深綠色鑲金袖口。臉頰旁飄浮著兩顆粉紅色愛心，襯著薄荷綠條紋背景，右上方以橙色花體字寫著「To Saren」，並附有畫師簽名。

art.title: Character Reference Sheet
art.description: Flat cel-shaded character reference sheet for Saren (些雲 / 沙雲), a spotted tan lynx with a cream mane, ear tufts and blue eyes, laid out on a mint-green background. Full-body front and back views show a green crop top with gold trim, dark sleeve cuff, blue sash and harem pants decorated with gold cloud motifs, plus a long spotted tail. Between them are accessory details: gold necklace and ring, cuff and striped-fabric swatches, a gold cloud pattern, and a paw-print reference. Six head studies at upper right cover smiling, winking, profile, shy, and surprised expressions, with a color palette strip along the bottom.
art.descriptionZH: 扁平賽璐璐風格的角色參考圖，主角為 Saren（些雲／沙雲）——一隻帶斑點的黃褐色猞猁，米白色鬃毛、耳尖簇毛、藍色眼睛，整體置於薄荷綠背景上。全身正面與背面視圖展示綠色金邊短上衣、深色袖口，以及飾有金色雲紋的藍色腰帶與燈籠褲，並可見細長的斑點尾巴。中間為配飾細節：金色項鍊與戒指、袖口與條紋布料樣本、金色雲紋圖案及腳印參考。右上方六個頭部表情涵蓋微笑、眨眼、側面、害羞與驚訝，底部為色板條。

art.title: Sunset Tree Lean
art.description: Saren, a tan lynx character with a cream mane, blue eyes, and blue-tipped ear tufts, leans with arms crossed against the trunk of a large leafy tree, gazing off pensively at the horizon. He wears a green sleeveless outfit with gold trim, a teal sash with gold chain belts, and gold wrist cuffs, his long fluffy tail curving behind him. Behind him a dramatic painterly sunset fills the sky with orange, pink, and slate-blue clouds over distant mountains and a sunlit green grassland. The artist's golden signature appears in the lower right corner.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 是一隻棕褐色猞猁，擁有奶油色鬃毛、藍色眼睛和藍色耳尖簇毛，雙臂交叉倚靠在一棵枝葉茂密的大樹樹幹上，若有所思地眺望地平線。他身穿金色鑲邊的綠色無袖服裝，繫著青綠色腰帶與金色鏈飾，手腕佩戴金色護腕，蓬鬆的長尾在身後彎曲。身後戲劇性的繪畫風日落將天空染成橙色、粉色與灰藍色雲彩，遠山連綿，陽光灑在翠綠的草原上。右下角可見藝術家的金色簽名。

art.title: Reference Sheet Clean
art.description: Clean character reference sheet for Saren, a tan, spotted lynx-like character with a cream mane, blue eyes, dark-tufted ears and horns, and a long fluffy tail. Shows full-body front and back views flanking five head expression studies (grinning, laughing, profile, playful tongue-out, and wide-eyed surprise), plus a paw print reference and a color palette strip. Flat cel-shaded style with clean lineart on a mint green background, with the character's name lettering at top left and an artist signature at bottom right.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 的乾淨角色參考圖，角色為一隻淺褐色帶斑點的猞猁型人物，擁有奶油色鬃毛、藍色眼睛、耳部和角上有深色簇毛，以及一條長而蓬鬆的尾巴。兩側為全身正面與背面視圖，中間是五個頭部表情研究（咧嘴笑、大笑、側臉、俏皮吐舌、睜大眼睛的驚訝），並附有腳印參考與色板條。乾淨線稿搭配平塗賽璐珞上色，置於薄荷綠背景上，左上角為角色名稱字樣，右下角有作者簽名。

art.title: Reaching Pose with Tooth Necklace
art.description: Anime-style digital illustration of Saren, a spotted lynx with tan fur, a fluffy white chest mane and forelock, and bright blue eyes, smiling confidently at the viewer. One heavily foreshortened clawed paw reaches toward the camera while the other rests on his hip. He wears a fang necklace on a cord, an open green jacket draped over his shoulders over a bare chest, dark shorts with a brown belt, and a sheathed sword at his hip, his long spotted tail curling up behind him. The backdrop is a softly blurred outdoor scene of forest and water.
art.descriptionZH: 動漫風格的數位插畫，Saren 是一隻斑點猞猁，棕褐色毛髮、蓬鬆的白色胸鬃與瀏海，亮藍色眼睛，自信地微笑直視觀眾。一隻帶爪的爪子以強烈的透視縮影效果伸向鏡頭，另一隻爪則叉在腰間。他頸上戴著繩繫牙齒項鍊，敞開的綠色外套披在雙肩上，露出胸膛，下身穿深色短褲配棕色腰帶，腰際佩著連鞘長劍，身後細長的斑點尾巴向上捲曲。背景為柔和模糊的森林與流水景緻。

art.title: Traditional Robes
art.description: Saren stands in ornate layered traditional East Asian robes of sage green, orange, and brown, trimmed with diamond patterns and tied with red braided cords and decorative knots. The lynx character has tawny fur, a white mane, dark horns, and bright blue eyes, posed with one paw raised. Accessories include tassel earrings, a large green gem at the waist, and wooden clogs, all rendered in a clean flat cel-shaded style against a solid warm orange background.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 身著華麗的層疊傳統東亞長袍，以灰綠、橙色和棕色為主，飾有菱形圖案，並繫著紅色編繩與裝飾繩結。這隻猞猁角色擁有棕褐色毛髮、白色鬃毛、深色雙角和明亮的藍色眼睛，姿態為一隻爪子抬起。配飾包括流蘇耳環、腰間的大型綠色寶石和木製木屐，以乾淨的平塗賽璐璐風格呈現，背景為純淨的溫暖橙色。

art.title: Colored Pencil Head Sketch
art.description: Hand-drawn commission from artist FenrirSchwart: Saren's head and shoulders rendered in ink outlines with light colored-pencil shading on a torn sheet of notepad paper. The white-furred beast snarls with bared fangs, narrowed blue eyes, small orange horn-like spots on the forehead and shoulder, and long claws crossed over the chest. A handwritten 'To. Saren' dedication, artist signature, and the date '2024.6.10' appear in the upper right corner.
art.descriptionZH: 畫師 FenrirSchwart 的手繪委託作品，以墨水線稿搭配淡色鉛筆著色，將 Saren 的頭部與肩膀繪於撕下的筆記本紙頁上。白色毛髮的獸人角色齜牙獰笑，藍色雙眼微眯，額頭與肩部點綴淺橙色角狀斑紋，長爪橫於胸前。右上角手寫「To. Saren」題字、畫師簽名及日期「2024.6.10」清晰可見。

art.title: Warrior with Bone Armor
art.description: Commissioned artwork by FenrirSchwart depicting Saren as a fierce lynx warrior, snarling with bared teeth in a wide battle stance drawn from a low angle. He wears a rust-brown patterned tunic trimmed with claws and fangs, cinched with a tan sash and a winged metal brooch, and carries a dark blade in one paw and a glossy blue shield studded with gold stars on the other. The full-body composition places him on a green field with pale stone ruins and distant hills under a bright blue sky, rendered in a clean cel-shaded comic style with the artist's red signature in the corner.
art.descriptionZH: 由畫師 FenrirSchwart 繪製的委約作品，Saren 化身威猛的猞猁戰士，齜牙怒吼，以低視角呈現雙腳開立的戰鬥姿態。他身穿鏽褐色紋理戰衣，綴有爪、牙裝飾，腰繫淺褐色腰帶，胸前別著飛翼造型的金屬胸針，一隻爪子握著深色長刃，另一側架著飾有金色星星的亮藍色盾牌。構圖為全身像，立於綠色草地上，背景為淺色石造廢墟與遠山，藍天明朗，整體以乾淨的賽璐璐漫畫風格繪製，角落有畫師的紅色簽名。

art.title: Aquatic Reach
art.description: Anime-style commission portrait of Saren, a cream-furred spotted lynx with a fluffy white mane, large pointed ears, and half-lidded bright blue eyes. He smiles shyly, a small fang showing, holding one clawed paw to his mouth while reaching the other hand up toward the viewer from turquoise water below. He wears a green vest patterned with a gold crisscross lattice, with gold cuff bracelets on his wrists. A soft, glowing yellow-green background scattered with light sparkles frames the high-angle close-up.
art.descriptionZH: 動漫風格的約稿肖像，Saren 是一隻奶白色帶斑點的猞猁，擁有蓬鬆的白色鬃毛、尖立的大耳朵和半闔的亮藍色雙眼。他羞澀地微笑並露出一顆小犬齒，一隻帶爪的爪子掩著嘴，另一隻手從下方的碧綠水面伸向觀眾。他身穿鑲有金色菱格圖案的綠色背心，手腕佩戴金色袖口鐲。柔和發光的黃綠色背景散落著點點光斑，襯托出這張高角度特寫。

art.title: Roaring Run
art.description: Commissioned piece by himasora showing Saren at a full sprint, seen in side profile mid-stride and roaring with an open mouth. A muscular lynx with tawny spotted fur, a shaggy cream mane, blue eyes, and clenched fists, wearing simple green trousers with a dark belt. A long spotted tail with a darker tip curves in an S-shape behind him. Rendered in a clean comic style with flat colors and crisp outlines against a solid muted teal background, with small motion flecks emphasizing speed.
art.descriptionZH: 委託 himasora 創作的作品：Saren 全力衝刺，以側面呈現跨步姿態，張口咆哮。肌肉發達的猞猁，黃褐色毛髮帶深色斑點，蓬鬆的奶油色鬃毛，藍色眼睛，雙拳緊攥，身穿綠色長褲並繫深色腰帶。帶有深色尾尖的長斑點尾巴在身後彎成 S 形。乾淨的漫畫風格繪製，扁平上色與俐落描邊，襯以純色柔和青色背景，細小動效碎屑強調速度感。

art.title: Kokumo Roaring Run
art.description: Commissioned character art of Kokumo, a muscular dark gray furred dragon with a shaggy white mane and chest fur, red eyes, and white claws. Captured mid-stride in a dynamic running pose with one arm cocked into a raised fist and the other knee lifted, face set in a closed-mouth snarl. He wears baggy teal pants, and his large crescent-curved tail, white-furred along the underside, sweeps in a full arc behind him. Rendered in a clean flat cel-shaded cartoon style with minimal shading against a solid muted brown background.
art.descriptionZH: 委託創作的角色圖，Kokumo 是一隻肌肉發達的深灰色毛龍，擁有蓬亂的白色鬃毛與胸毛、紅色雙眼和白色爪尖。畫面捕捉他奔跑中的動態姿勢，單臂彎起握拳高舉、另一側膝蓋抬起，臉部為閉口的齜牙表情。身穿寬鬆青色長褲，巨大的新月形彎尾下半部帶白色毛髮，在身後劃出完整弧線。以乾淨的平塗卡通風格繪製，陰影簡潔，背景為純霧棕色。

art.title: Japanese Garden Night
art.description: Saren, a tan lynx with a cream mane and blue eyes, sits relaxed at night on the wooden veranda of a traditional Japanese house, one leg stretched out to show his paw pads. He wears a white robe with blue trim over dark trousers and holds a red bowl in both paws, gazing off with a faint smile. Behind him a leafy tree glows amid drifting fireflies, with tiled roofs and a stone wall under a full moon. A soft, semi-realistic digital painting in cool blue night tones with a quiet, contemplative mood.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 是一隻棕褐色毛髮、奶油色鬃毛、藍色眼睛的猞猁，夜晚悠閒地坐在傳統日式房屋的木地板廊緣，一條腿伸展露出肉墊。他身穿藍色滾邊的白色長袍，內搭深色長褲，雙爪捧著一隻紅色碗，嘴角帶著淡淡微笑望向遠方。身後的樹木在飛舞的螢火蟲光點中微微發光，背景是瓦頂屋舍與石牆，天邊掛著一輪滿月。整體為柔和的半寫實數位繪畫，以冷調藍色夜色為主，氣氛安靜而沉靜。

art.title: Chubby Belly Pose
art.description: Saren kneeling and holding his round belly with both paws in a lighthearted pose. A tawny, spotted big-cat with bright blue eyes, a fluffy cream mane and black-tufted ears, wearing a green cropped vest with yellow geometric trim over a dark green shirt, gold cuff bracelet and matching armband. Soft flat coloring with clean lineart on a plain light gray background.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 跪坐著，雙掌捧起圓滾滾的肚子，姿態輕鬆幽默。黃褐色斑點的大貓身軀，藍眼睛，蓬鬆的奶油色鬃毛與黑色耳尖，身穿帶黃色幾何紋飾的綠色短背心和深綠色內衣，搭配金色手鐲與同色係臂環。柔和的平塗上色搭配乾淨線稿，背景為簡潔的淺灰色。

art.title: Relaxed Sit
art.description: Saren, a spotted golden-orange lynx-like character with a thick cream mane and ear tufts, sits in a relaxed pose with one arm draped over a raised knee and a calm half-smile. Teal-blue eyes and a long tail curling across the foreground anchor the composition. Digital illustration with smooth cel-style shading and bold outlines on a plain white background, signed and dated '23 by Falvie.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 是一位帶斑點的橙金色山貓形角色，頸部與耳部有厚實的奶油色鬃毛和耳簇，以放鬆姿勢坐著，單臂搭在曲起的膝蓋上，神情平靜而略帶微笑。藍綠色雙眼與橫掃前景的長尾巴構成畫面重點。數位插畫，採用平滑的賽璐珞式上色與清晰線稿，純白背景，Falvie 簽名並標註 '23。

art.title: Techwear Hoodie
art.description: Saren, a muscular lynx character with tan spotted fur, a fluffy pale mane, black-tipped ears, and bright blue eyes, shown in a relaxed three-quarter pose looking back over his shoulder. He wears a black short-sleeved hooded top with glowing cyan stripes and matching shorts, one paw raised near his collar and the other tucked in a pocket, his long tan tail curling upward behind him. Flat cel-shaded cartoon style with clean linework, set against a dark textured background with a glowing cyan parallelogram and diagonal shafts of shadow. Signed 'Mei 2024'; a commissioned artwork.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 是一名肌肉健壯的猞猁角色，棕褐色皮毛帶有深色斑點，頸部環繞蓬鬆的淺色鬃毛，耳尖呈黑色，雙眼為亮藍色。他以休閒的四分之三側身姿勢回望觀者，身穿帶有發光青色條紋的黑色短袖連帽上衣與同色短褲，一隻爪子抬至領口旁，另一隻插入口袋，長長的棕褐色尾巴在身後向上彎曲。乾淨線稿搭配平塗賽璐璐著色的卡通風格，深色質紋背景中襯有一塊發光的青色平行光塊，並有斜射的光影。畫面署名為 Mei 2024，為一幅委約作品。

art.title: Tactical Lounging
art.description: Saren, a spotted serval-like fursona with a white chest tuft and blue eyes, lounges back on the ground in a relaxed legs-crossed pose so the soles of his tech sneakers face the viewer. He wears a dark sleeveless vest over an open white shirt, brown cargo pants, fingerless gloves, and a black armband, with his long fluffy tail curled out in front. Flat cel-shaded anime style with clean lineart on a plain taupe background; signed and dated 2023 by the artist.
art.descriptionZH: Saren——一頭身形結實的藪貓型獸人角色，白色胸毛、藍色雙眼——懶散地後傾坐地，雙腿交叉翹起，鞋底正對觀者。他身穿深色無袖背心，內搭敞開的白色襯衫、棕色工裝長褲、半指手套與黑色臂環，蓬鬆的長尾向前捲曲。畫面採扁平賽璐璐風格的日本動畫式上色與乾淨線稿，背景為單純的灰褐色，並有作者簽名及 2023 年年份標記。

art.title: Fursuit Head Portrait
art.description: Portrait photograph of the Saren fursuit head, a handmade lynx-style head with tan and cream fur, a fluffy white mane, and dark-tipped ears. The head is turned in a three-quarter view with glowing teal-green eyes looking toward the camera. A black woven blanket with white Nordic-style zigzag patterns is draped over the shoulders, contrasting with the warm fur tones. Shot indoors in dim light against a softly blurred room background. Fursuit by Inerri Creatures.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 毛絨服頭部的肖像照片，為手工製作的猞猁風格頭套，毛色呈棕褐色與奶油色，頸部有蓬鬆的白色鬃毛，耳尖帶有深色。頭部以四分之三側面轉向鏡頭，發光的青綠色雙眼望向前方。肩上披著黑白北歐風格鋸齒圖案的織毯，與溫暖的毛色形成對比。於室內昏暗光線下拍攝，背景為柔和模糊的房間。毛絨服由 Inerri Creatures 製作。

art.title: Harbor Sunset Photo
art.description: Travel photo of Saren riding a ferry across Victoria Harbour (Hong Kong) at golden hour. The tan-and-white lynx, with bright green eyes, appears in a head-and-shoulders composition, wrapped in a dark poncho with orange geometric trim and resting plush paws on the metal railing. Behind, Hong Kong Island's skyscrapers and mountains glow in warm low sunlight while a painted ferry crosses the water nearby. Fursuit by Inerri Creatures.
art.descriptionZH: 黃金時刻搭乘渡輪橫越維多利亞港（香港）時拍攝的 Saren 旅行照。棕褐色與白色毛髮的猞猁雙眼呈亮綠色，畫面以頭部與肩部構圖呈現，身披飾有橙色幾何圖案的深色披肩，毛絨雙爪搭在金屬護欄上。背景中香港島的摩天大樓與山脈沐浴在溫暖的低角度陽光下，附近一艘彩繪渡輪駛過水面。毛絨服由 Inerri Creatures 製作。

art.title: Night Balcony Photo
art.description: Saren fursuit photographed at night on a high-rise balcony, shown in three-quarter profile with green eyes and a cream mane over a black jacket and white shirt. One paw rests on the railing while blue and colorful skyscraper lights fill the dark city skyline behind. Fursuit by Inerri Creatures.
art.descriptionZH: 夜晚在高樓陽臺上拍攝的 Saren 毛絨服，以四分之三側身入鏡，綠色雙眼，奶油色鬃毛，身穿黑色夾克與白襯衫。一隻爪子搭在護欄上，身後漆黑城市天際線中的摩天大樓亮著藍色與多彩燈光。毛絨服由 Inerri Creatures 製作。

art.title: Meow
art.description: Cartoon illustration of Meow from Space Dandy, the cat character wearing a red hood with a yellow smiley emblem. Cream-faced with amber eyes, lowered brows and a fanged, mischievous grin, he raises both grey paws to show pink paw pads in a playful pose, with a yellow cuff on one wrist and light green crossed straps over his chest. Flat cel-style coloring with clean outlines against a blue background with diagonal lighter bands.
art.descriptionZH: 卡通插畫，《宇宙浪子》中的 Meow，貓角色戴著帶有黃色微笑徽章的紅色兜帽。米色臉龐、琥珀色雙眼，皺眉並露出帶有小虎牙的調皮笑容，舉起灰色雙爪展示粉色肉球，擺出俏皮姿勢，其中一隻手腕戴黃色腕環，胸前交叉淺綠色背帶。賽璐珞風格平塗上色、線條乾淨，藍色背景帶斜向淺色條紋。

art.title: Shower Scene
art.description: 3D rendered realistic-style Saren, a tan and white lynx-like character with bright blue eyes, black-tipped ears and a fluffy cream mane, standing in a modern corner shower with one paw held to his chest. Muscular build, full-body fursuit-like fur rendering, long tail trailing behind. A black rain shower head overhead, dark wooden shelves with a teal soap dispenser, and a floor-to-ceiling window showing a calm ocean under a soft cloudy sky. Composed as a tall full-body portrait lit by natural daylight. 3D model modified from: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/cougar-d9dc5171a1a14674a0313df212d12c87
art.descriptionZH: 3D 渲染寫實風格的 Saren，棕褐色與白色毛髮的猞猁風格角色，湛藍雙眼，耳尖黑色，頸部環繞蓬鬆的奶白色鬃毛，站在現代轉角淋浴間中，一隻爪子輕按胸前。體格健壯，全身毛髮質感接近毛絨服工藝，長尾垂於身後。頭頂為黑色雨淋式花灑，右側深色木架上放著青綠色乳液瓶，落地窗外是柔和多雲天空下的平靜海景。以豎幅全身構圖呈現，採自然日光照明。3D 模型修改自：https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/cougar-d9dc5171a1a14674a0313df212d12c87

art.title: Back View Hoodie
art.description: Sketch-style illustration of Saren, a lynx character with a flowing white mane, tan spotted fur, and large pointed ears, seen from behind with his head turned to show a right-facing profile and one blue eye. A dark jacket hangs slipped off his shoulders, leaving his pale torso, faint ab definition, and tan spots exposed above a dark belt at the hip. Loose ink linework and soft watercolor-like shading sit against a plain white background for a light, airy mood.
art.descriptionZH: 素描風格插畫，從後方描繪猞猁角色 Saren，頭部轉向右側呈現側臉，露出一隻藍色眼睛、飄逸的白色鬃毛、棕褐色斑點毛髮與大型尖耳。深色外套自雙肩滑落，露出淺色軀幹、隱約的腹部肌肉線條與腰際深色腰帶上方的棕褐色斑點。寬鬆的墨線勾勒搭配柔和如水彩的上色，置於純白背景之上，營造輕盈通透的氛圍。

art.title: Voxel Saren Model
art.description: Screenshot of the Blender 4.1 viewport showing a voxel-style model of Saren built from large cubes in a Minecraft-like aesthetic. The blocky lynx has tan and gold fur on the head, ears and arms, a white mane and chest, blue pixel eyes, and a tail tipped in black. He stands in a three-quarter pose on a plain grey plane under a clear gradient sky, casting a hard shadow, with Blender's menu bar and timeline visible around the frame.
art.descriptionZH: Blender 4.1 視口截圖，展示以大立方體堆砌而成、Minecraft 風格的體素版 Saren 模型。方塊狀的猞猁頭部、耳朵與雙臂為棕褐色與金色毛髮，鬃毛和胸部為白色，藍色像素眼睛，尾巴尖端呈黑色。以四分之三側身姿勢站在純灰色平面上，上方為晴朗的漸層天空，投射出清晰的陰影，畫面周邊可見 Blender 的菜單欄與時間軸。

art.title: Math Sketch
art.description: Loose digital sketch of Saren, a tan-furred lynx with a shaggy white mane and beard, tufted ears and bright blue eyes, in a soft painterly style on a plain white background. He grins playfully with one paw thrust toward the viewer in exaggerated foreshortening, claws and dark paw pads visible, while his other arm stretches out to the side and a long spotted tail curves up behind him. He wears a dark grey t-shirt and black shorts, and a handwritten summation formula is scribbled at his side.
art.descriptionZH: 輕鬆的數位素描，描繪 Saren——一隻淺棕色毛髮的猞猁，蓬鬆的白色鬃毛與鬍鬚，耳尖有毛束，亮藍色眼睛，風格柔和且帶有手繪筆觸，背景為純白。他俏皮地笑著，一爪以誇張透視直伸向觀眾，露出爪尖與深色肉墊，另一隻手臂平舉伸向一旁，身後一條帶斑點的大尾巴向上彎起。他穿著深灰色 T 恤和黑色短褲，旁邊手寫著一道數學求和公式。

art.title: 3D Model Render
art.description: 3D model turntable render of Saren, an anthropomorphic lynx, posed in a wide T-pose against a flat black background. Tan and cream fur with a white feathered chest and mane, gray spots scattered across the thighs, and tufts of white spikes along the shoulders, legs and outer arms. Muscular build with defined abs, large clawed hands and feet, bright blue eyes, and a long spotted tail with a white spiked underside hanging between the legs.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 的 3D 模型展示渲染圖，呈張開的 T 姿勢，置於純黑背景前。棕褐色與奶油色毛髮，白色羽毛狀胸部與鬃毛，大腿佈有灰色斑點，肩部、腿部與手臂外側沿著白色尖刺狀毛叢。身材肌肉健壯、腹肌分明，帶爪的大型手掌與雙腳，亮藍色眼睛，夾於雙腿間下垂的長斑點尾巴底部帶有白色尖刺。

art.title: 3D Model Side Profile
art.description: 3D rendered side profile of Saren facing left against a black background, arm reaching forward with white claws extended. Tan fur with a thick white mane, blue eyes, and dark spots across the shoulder and tail, wearing a green outfit with gold trim, a blue sash, and gold swirl embroidery on the legs. The long tail is lined with a row of white serrated fur, and detailed fur work covers the mane, belly and tail edge.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 的 3D 渲染側面像，面向左、黑色背景，向前伸手露出白色爪尖。棕褐色毛髮配厚實白色鬃毛、藍色眼睛，肩部與尾巴上有深色斑點，身穿綠色服裝，金色鑲邊、藍色腰帶，腿部有金色捲紋刺繡。長尾下緣排著一排鋸齒狀白色絨毛，鬃毛、腹部與尾緣的毛髮細節刻畫精緻。

art.title: Green Armor Side Profile
art.description: Commission-style illustration of Saren's fursona by artist Metoro: a lion/cheetah-like character with spotted golden-tan fur, a thick cream mane, and bright blue eyes, shown in a three-quarter side view leaning forward with one hand on the hip. Dressed in an open green shirt with gold-trimmed diamond patterning, a brown leather shoulder pauldron set with a teal gem, black arm wraps, a collar with turquoise beads, and green patterned trousers with a jeweled belt pendant. A handwritten 'Saren様 Thank you!' message with leaf accents sits in the top-left corner, with the artist's signature mid-frame. Warm palette on a plain cream backdrop with soft palm-leaf shadows.
art.descriptionZH: 畫師 Metoro 為 Saren 的獸設創作的委託插畫：獅/豹型角色，金棕色皮毛帶斑點，濃密奶油色鬃毛，明亮的藍色眼睛，以四分之三側身視角呈現，身體前傾、一手叉腰。身穿滾金鑽紋圖案的綠色開襟上衣，棕色皮革肩甲鑲藍寶石，黑色手臂裹布、綠松石珠項圈，綠色圖紋長褲搭配寶石腰墜。左上角有手寫字樣「Saren様 Thank you!」並配以葉子裝飾，畫面中段有畫師簽名。暖色調配色，簡潔米色背景襯以柔和的棕葉陰影。

art.title: Cheerful Headshot
art.description: Cheerful headshot of Saren, a lynx-like fursona with tan fur, dark spots, and a fluffy white mane. Both paws are raised over the head, tousling the hair in a playful pose above a wide open-mouthed smile showing small fangs. Large ears with black tufts and bright blue eyes. Soft digital painting style on a plain white background.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 開朗的頭像，山貓造型的獸設，棕褐色皮毛帶有深色斑點，白色蓬鬆鬃毛。雙掌俏皮地舉過頭頂抓著頭髮，臉下是開懷的笑容，露出小犬齒。長著黑色耳簇的大耳朵，亮藍色眼睛。純白背景上的柔和數碼繪畫風格。

art.title: Saren Before the Luminous Orb
art.description: Saren stands on a mossy rock ledge at left, one foot raised and long tail curling behind, while a vast underground fairy city fills the dark cavern behind him, its tunnels and walls thick with countless tiny glowing homes and lanterns. He is a tan-faced lynx with a white spiky mane and blue eyes, wearing a jeweled circlet, a beaded teal cropped top over a bare midriff, and a tattered patchwork skirt hung with large colorful gemstones. At right, a huge luminous translucent sphere floats in the cavern, its cool light set against the warm amber glow of the city. Painterly fantasy illustration.
art.descriptionZH: Saren 站在左側布滿青苔的岩架上，一腳踩著岩石，長尾在身後捲曲；身後的幽暗洞穴中是龐大的地下精靈城市，隧道與岩壁遍佈無數微小的發光房屋與燈籠。他是棕褐色臉龐的猞猁，白色尖刺鬃毛，藍色眼睛，頭戴寶石頭冠，身穿綴珠的青綠色短上衣，露出腹部，下著破布拼接、懸掛大顆彩色寶石的裙裝。右側洞穴中漂浮著一顆巨大的發光半透明寶珠，冷色光輝與城市溫暖的琥珀色燈火相互映襯。繪畫風格奇幻插畫。
